direction: Turn a four-card configuration page into a state → act → result page: a compact status strip, a refresh toolbar in the header, condensed run history as the main surface, and all configuration plus diagnostics behind two on-demand drawers. Nothing is deleted; low-value, benign-state metadata and restated prose move behind existing disclosure.
main_tradeoff: Settings and diagnostics become one click away (slower for the rare tuning session) in exchange for the common run-and-watch workflow fitting above the fold on both widths; mitigated by auto-opening the Settings drawer whenever edits are dirty, invalid, or errored.

Connection details drawer, including rate limits and cooldowns

Run rows, field labels, feedback and error messages

usability_hazards: Never auto-collapse or re-mount the Settings drawer while dirty is true; unsaved operator edits are the costliest loss on this route.
Keep the 409 'Settings changed elsewhere. Compare latest settings, then retry' message and the 401/403 local-access message at top level, never inside a closed drawer.
The 3-second poll (tsx 226-256) must not re-mount <details> elements or move focus; keep them keyed and uncontrolled so an open drawer survives each refresh.
Cancel run must stay reachable without expanding per-run details, and cancelRequested must remain visible on the condensed row.
Smaller content volume must not shrink hit targets: preserve 44px minimum on buttons, selects, inputs and summaries.
Do not hide runDisabledReason, status.warnings, failed-run error labels or degraded source status; collapsing is for benign state only.
Removing the always-visible 'Manual refresh is available.' hint must not remove the aria-describedby target; keep the element rendered when a reason exists and preserve the accessible name otherwise.
Preserve the independent pause semantics comment at tsx 287: pause must continue to merge rather than discard unrelated draft edits.
acceptance_checks: At 1440 and 390, Run now is visible without scrolling past the header block.
In an idle, healthy, unpaused state the status strip shows at most four facts plus any warnings.
The full common loop (read state, choose scope, Run now, watch progress, read result) requires zero disclosure clicks.
A succeeded run occupies one line; a failed or skipped run shows its runErrorLabel text without expansion.
Edit a setting, let a poll cycle elapse, and the Settings drawer is still open with 'Unsaved changes' shown; submitting an invalid cron opens the drawer and focuses the invalid field.
A simulated 409 on save still surfaces the concurrent-edit message and Compare latest settings preserves the draft edits.
No rendered text is below 14px at either width, and all interactive controls remain at least 44px tall.
Pause/Resume, Cancel run and their disabled reasons retain identical wording and semantics to the current build.
coverage_limits: Only three static screenshots were available, all in one state: collections apparently accepting work, no active run, trade not configured, coverage 0/2, settings clean at version 4.
No active/queued run was observable, so the progress bar, Cancel run and cancelRequested presentation are judged from source (tsx 1032-1075), not from pixels.
Open/close behaviour of <details>, polling interaction with focus, and the dirty/Discard flow are inferred from AdminMarketPage.tsx; I did not run or drive the UI.
Error, loading, paused and unhealthy-worker renderings were not screenshotted; recommendations for them are source-derived.

Only AdminMarketPage.tsx and adminMarket.css were in scope, so shared tokens (--muted, --surface, --accent, root font size) and any global layout container were not inspected; the container-width and rem assumptions should be verified against the global stylesheet.
